CSV columns: category, date, end_date, duration_weeks, name, color. Use week numbers, YYYY-MM-DD or DD-MM-YYYY dates. Blank dates are kept as unscheduled events; empty separator rows are ignored. Set the wheel to the dates’ ISO year first. Colour: standard name, hex, highlight, or blank for the category’s normal colour.
